answer: The yarrow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the terrace. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing.
